maddeler.e:
أتباغض (form VI)
# أَتَبَاغَضُ (ʔatabāḡaḍu) /ʔa.ta.baː.ɣa.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# أَتَبَاغَضَ (ʔatabāḡaḍa) /ʔa.ta.baː.ɣa.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
# أَتَبَاغَضْ (ʔatabāḡaḍ) /ʔa.ta.baː.ɣadˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَبَاغَضَ (tabāḡaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
